name: Emergency Hemostatic Cocoon Response
description: A last-resort medical modification that triggers when the body detects catastrophic trauma — massive blood loss, organ perforation, or systemic shock. Modified blood cells and skin glands produce a rapid-setting biological cocoon around the injury site (or the entire body in cases of multiple-site trauma), sealing wounds, applying compression, and creating a sterile biological cast. The cocoon material is a fibrin-silk hybrid that sets in seconds, is breathable, and maintains the body in a stabilized state for up to 4 hours — long enough for emergency medical extraction in most situations. The user is conscious during cocoon formation and describes the experience as 'being wrapped in warm concrete.' The cocoon must be dissolved with an enzymatic solution for medical access. It is, essentially, the body's own emergency room — deployed automatically when all else fails.
source_organism: Bombyx mori (domestic silkworm, silk protein production), synthetic rapid-fibrin coagulation factors
procedure: Systemic retroviral treatment with dermal silk-gland implantation, 4 sessions over 2 months
reversibility: Silk glands surgically removable; blood cell modifications persist
side_effects: False activation during extreme stress or panic — the body wraps itself in a cocoon without actual trauma
Cocoon restricts movement and breathing — if not dissolved, can cause suffocation in 6–8 hours
Cocoon formation is visible and alarming — bystanders may assume the user is experiencing a terrifying body-horror event
Post-cocoon skin is raw and sensitive for days
Rare: cocoon formation traps broken bone fragments in incorrect positions, requiring surgical correction after dissolution
social_perception: Respected as a genuine lifesaver. Emergency medics love it — it buys them time. The visual experience of watching someone cocoon is deeply disturbing but medically miraculous. Users carry enzymatic dissolving solution as mandatory equipment.
story_hooks: A Death Wrap activates in a social situation without trauma — the false activation reveals that the user's body is responding to a poison so subtle that no other system detected it
A cocooned body is found in a restricted area — alive, stable, and sealed. When the cocoon is dissolved, the person inside has no memory of how they got there or what triggered the response
